draft_en.subject: AVCOMM 400 / 4000 series - a second-source quotation under your label
draft_en.body:
Hi Kang,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "Managed PoE Switches" on 28 September 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the AVCOMM 400 / 4000-series industrial PoE positions, under your label from small lots, -40 to 75 C, CE/RoHS/FCC: DIN-rail 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2 managed, Marvell-based - model STI-288GPM - $85.5 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); L2+ with ring redundancy - STI-288DGGPM - $137.5; the same footprint unmanaged - STI-288GP - $62.2. Your housing and label; the firmware web GUI carries the AVCOMM logo.

One question: which series would you want a second-source quotation on first - the managed 4000 or the unmanaged 400?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
